# Developer Tools: Overview

Along with the Moto Mods Development Kit, which simplifies your hardware development, the Moto Mods platform uses open source tools for compiling and debugging your project. Debugging and logging support on the Reference Moto Mod are exposed through a single USB Type C interface; no custom cables or connectors are required.  This section provides everything you need to start developing on a Linux based platform, without putting a dent in your budget.  All firmware and bootloader source code are available on github, as are utilities and example Android application code
